environment.description: Production Kubernetes cluster running the stream processor. LaunchDarkly project 'prod-streaming' has the flag 'enable-cross-origin-action-replay' set to TRUE for all users (rolled out at 100% during a migration that was never rolled back). Kafka topic 'user-actions' accepts messages from any authenticated producer. The service has unrestricted egress network policy.

config.kafka_acl: any authenticated producer can write to user-actions
